title: js-yaml: rename common.repeat to repeatString across modules
prompt: This is a copy of js-yaml 4.1.0 (index.js and lib/). The helper `repeat` exported from lib/common.js is easy to confuse with String.prototype.repeat. Rename it to `repeatString` and update every caller under lib/ (loader, dumper, snippet and anything else that uses it). The old export must be gone. Behaviour of load, dump and error snippets must not change.
